commits: refactor: migrate 'best' sync frequency to 'daily' and remove auto-calculation option
feat: handle Redfin AVM rate limiting by throwing a descriptive error and add corresponding unit test
feat: migrate property valuation service from RentCast to Redfin and clean up unused scratch files.
refactor: migrate backup and restore functionality from AdvancedTab to ImportExportTab
feat: implement comprehensive user data export system with custom CSV and report generation capabilities
refactor: harden CSRF protection with expanded proxy validation and improve backup import data integrity checks
feat: add plan data to backups and enable cross-user alert rule evaluation for share groups
feat: implement account grouping logic and unify transaction filtering by asset class
feat: add projection options popover and integrate simulation controls across planning tabs
feat: add IRMAA tax planning tab and introduce tax-deferred first withdrawal strategy
feat: make projection controls collapsible and optimize tab navigation styling
feat: add Social Security utility for benefit calculations and restrict account scope to FIRE-eligible assets across UI components
refactor: remove outdated documentation specs and update retirement engine logic
chore: upgrade core dependencies, update archiver implementation, and improve VAPID initialization logic
feat: add AiSuggestionsModal for interactive transaction categorization and rule management
feat: add rothPercentage configuration to retirement accounts to support tax-advantaged split balances
fix: implement penalty-aware withdrawal logic and ensure proper cost basis tracking for tax-free accounts
chore: revert plan account changes and add migration self-heal for plan_settings penalty withdrawals
feat: add allowPenaltyWithdrawals setting to retirement engine and UI, update account types, and visualize shortfall in projections.
feat: add retirement planning contribution configurations and projection dashboard enhancements
feat: enable nullable inputs in plan-wizard-modal and track sourcePlanId in plan updates
refactor: improve salary base calculations, add employer match redirection for Roth 401k, and update cost basis logic for taxable contributions.
refactor: unify contribution logic and add input tooltips to retirement engine and plan details UI
feat: add withdrawal strategy selector, diagnostic warnings, and shortfall visualization to projection dashboard
feat: add salary projections to retirement plans and visualize early withdrawal penalties in projections UI
feat: migrate salary tracking from event-based to native plan properties with salary raise overrides.
feat: add salary-based account contribution logic and configurable employer matching settings to the retirement planning engine
refactor: remove automatic default plan creation, update plan deletion flow, and enhance projection tooltips with per-account breakdowns
feat: add salary_source column to plan_flows table
refactor: extract engine rules management into a reusable EngineRulesView component and update empty state messaging
